lines: {target}? Strange quiet can make a place feel too safe. I would pack food for the road.
If anyone heads for Mushroom Fields, tell them: Eat only what you know and keep your boat close. I will be at the smoker.
Mycelium underfoot is not village dirt. I will remember that when I pack food.
Mushroom Fields is no small story. Hungry folk make poor choices.
I will remember Mushroom Fields as odd land where even the grass changed its mind. I will keep stew warm for anyone who comes back shaking.
{target}? Open ground shows you to everything else. I would pack food for the road.
If anyone heads for Plains, tell them: Keep moving and watch the horizon. I will be at the smoker.
Grass bends before trouble arrives if you look. I will remember that when I pack food.
Plains is no small story. Hungry folk make poor choices.
I will remember Plains as wide land with nowhere to hide after dark. I will keep stew warm for anyone who comes back shaking.
